h:
LTXV 的工作流程非常简单。没有即时增强器；在我看来，作为 ComfyUI 中的工具，它是无用的垃圾，而且文本 LLM 工作在 ComfyUI 中大多运行速度非常慢。不存在潜在的升级。几乎都是一样的无用垃圾。也许这对 T2V 等有用。

设置全分辨率将优于半分辨率和带有插值结果的潜在升级，即使它需要像第二代这样的资源。如果您的系统对于您设置的完整分辨率而言不够强大，则几乎可以肯定服务器将在潜在的高档阶段耗尽内存。在使用像素升级器本身的 IMG2video 情况下，情况甚至更糟。

该工作流程在我的 8GB VRAM 显卡上以 720p 运行良好；我还没有在带有蒸馏 lora 的 FP8 开发模型上尝试过更高分辨率。控制它与我的其他工作流程相同。如果您尝试我的工作流程之一，它也会相似。

请注意V2V组下的备注。我也尝试过OpenPose和canny；它们比深度掩模差得多。

我试过了洛拉ID，也许它很好，但非常慢

我试过了LTX 总监，我发现它的潜力非常高，但在日常使用中我不喜欢它的实际工作原理。

我不喜欢这种方式梦想的代价是什么的节点看起来在那里（因为 JavaScript 节点“想要”为默认大小），但这是我能做的最好的方法。

o.en:
Pretty simple workflow for LTXV. There is no prompt enchancer; in my opinion, it's useless garbage as a tool in ComfyUI, and text LLM work mostly works very slow in ComfyUI. There is no latent upscaling. Almost the same useless garbage. Maybe this is useful for T2V and that all.

Setting the full resolution will be better than half resolution and latent upscaling with an interpolated result, even it requires resources like second generation. If your system is not powerful enough for the full resolution you set, almost certainly the server will run out of memory on the latent upscale stage. And that's even worse in IMG2video cases with the pixel upscaler itself.

The workflow works fine on my 8GB VRAM videocard at 720p; I haven't tried higher resolution yet on FP8 dev model with distilled lora. Controlling it is the same as any other my workflow. If you try even one of my workflows, it will be similar.

Put your attention on the note under V2V group. I also tried OpenPose and canny; they are much worse than Depth mask.

I triedID Lora, maybe it's good but extremely slow

I triedLTX Director, and I found its potential very high, but in common use I don't like how it actually works.

I don’t like the wayWhatdreamscost’s nodes look there (because JavaScript nodes “want” to be default size), yet this is the best way I could do.
